spec.vuln_cue: mentions they had an operation last month

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Declan Pemberton. I’m really unhappy about the unarranged overdraft fees on my account.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had to call about that, Declan. I can see a £25 fee was charged on 14 October, and your balance is currently £312 overdrawn.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s what I’m calling about. I had an operation last month, and all this has been a lot to deal with.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand you’re unhappy with the fee. Can you tell me what you feel has gone wrong?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I didn’t realise I’d gone over my arranged limit, and I don’t think the fee is fair. I want the bank to look into it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m logging this as a complaint about the unarranged overdraft fee and how it was applied.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thank you. I’d like someone to properly review it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of getting it recorded today, and I’ll make sure the complaints team has your concerns to review.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will the money definitely be refunded?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise what the outcome will be. The complaints team will look into the circumstances and explain its decision in writing.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. What happens now, then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit the complaint today. The complaints team will investigate and send you a full written response within 8 weeks. If they need anything else, they’ll contact you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, so you’re logging it today, and I’ll get the full response within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’ll make sure it’s logged today. Does that make sense, and is there anything else you’d like me to clarify?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Declan. Thanks for speaking with me, and I’m sorry this has been frustrating.
